competences.description: Smites the enemy, removing 1 beneficial effect and decreasing Attack Speed and Attack Power for 3 turns.
Strikes all enemies, decreasing their Defense for 3 turns.

Whenever attacked, deals damage to the attacker with burning flames and recovers the Boss's HP in proportion to the damage dealt. If the Boss receives 0 damage from the enemy, increases the damage dealing to the attacker and the Boss's HP by 100% each. [Automatic Effect]
